Sol claimed to be the officer on day one and said he had been shown Gemma as a killer, and the town voted Gemma out that day, where her card showed killer. On night two, Luna claimed to be the doctor and protected Sol, and nobody died. On day two, Haiku voted for Sol instead of Gemma, and Sonnet kept pressing Haiku for a real reason until the instinct excuse fell apart. The town then voted Haiku out, and Haiku's card showed killer, so every killer was gone and the town won.
